data.name: Aminatou
data.gender_notes: Aminatou is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘amin’, meaning trust, faith, and reliability. The name Aminatou carries the meaning “Trustworthy, Reliable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aminatou usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, reliable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of Allah in one's life, instilling faith, trust, and inner peace.
data.etymology: Aminatou belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, Reliable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aminatou total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أميناتو
in_arabic.meaning: أميناتو تعني الامينة والموثوقة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أميناتو مشتق من الجذر العربي أ-م-ن، ويعني الشخص الذي يعتبر آمنًا وموثوقًا، وجديرًا بالثقة. في سياق التسمية الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم أميناتو تعبيرًا عن الصفات الحميدة مثل الأمانة والصدق والموثوقية. وقد وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قول الله تعالى: {إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تُؤَدُّوا الْأَمَانَاتِ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا} (النساء: 58).

in_urdu.name: اميناتو
in_urdu.meaning: اميناتو کا مطلب ہے قابل اعتماد اور ایمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: اميناتو نام عربی جڑ أ-م-ن سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ایک قابل اعتماد اور قابل احترام شخص۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، یہ نام اچھے اخلاق جیسے امانت، صدق اور وفاداری کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کی تاریخی اہمیت ہے اور اس کا استعمال آج بھی مسلم ممالک میں جاری ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अमीनातो
in_hindi.meaning: अमीनातो का अर्थ है विश्वासपात्र और ईमानदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीनातो नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल अ-म-न से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है एक विश्वासपात्र और सच्चा व्यक्ति। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अच्छे गुणों जैसे कि ईमानदारी, सच्चाई और निष्ठा का प्रतीक है। इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक और आधुनिक दोनों संदर्भों में किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: امیناتو
in_pashto.meaning: امیناتو د اعتماد او ایمان معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د امیناتو نوم د عربی جڑ أ-م-ن څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د اعتماد او احترام معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې، دا نوم د نیکو صفاتو لکه امانت، صدق او وفادارۍ څرګندونه کوي. دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او ژبې کې مهم ځای لري.

in_english.name: Aminatou
in_english.meaning: Aminatou means trustworthy and faithful in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aminatou originates from the Arabic root أ-م-ن (a-m-n), which conveys the meaning of a trustworthy and faithful individual. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies good qualities such as honesty, sincerity, and reliability. Referenced in several Quranic verses, including Surah An-Nisa, verse 58, it emphasizes the importance of fulfilling trusts. Aminatou is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing virtues of integrity and moral character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aminatou, derived from the Arabic word ‘amin’, holds a rich cultural significance as it reflects the values of trust, faithfulness, and stability - traits highly valued in Islamic and West African cultures where the name is commonly used.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Aminatou symbolizes trust in one's faith and in the divine power of Allah. It carries a reminder for its bearer to cultivate a solid foundation of faith, consciousness, and trust in Allah, while showing reliability and trustworthiness towards others and oneself. The name resonates with Muslim women's inner strength and their commitment to uphold moral values and provide stability for their communities.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aminatou was a noblewoman in the court of Mali Empire, around 13th century. The name Aminatou carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aminatou is of Berber origin and means 'faithful'. It is a popular name in West Africa and is often given to girls. In modern times, the name has gained popularity through social media and baby name websites.
